title: GURPS Monster Hunters 1: Champions
label: GURPS Monster Hunters 1
notes: GCA cites this book as MH1:23. The system parser pinned at v1.0.0 only reads that with the colon in the prefix; from the release carrying sargas79/GWorldVTT#138 the prefix can be plain MH1. The data file has no templates, and PDF page = book page. The data file files each power's abilities under a prefix (BIO:, MYS:, ESP:, PK:, TEL:, TPN:) the book does not print.
